questions.stem: Using the pulse rate data from the previous question (median = 75, Q1 = 69.5, Q3 = 78.5), which five-number summary would correctly draw the boxplot for this data?
questions.hint: The whiskers of a boxplot run out to the actual minimum and maximum data values, not the calculated quartiles.
questions.solution: The full ordered list starts at 60 and ends at 90, so those are the whisker ends.
